messages:
emma: FYI found a 404 in the serving runtime kernel-selection guide, section 'kernel selection heuristics' — the example kernel manifest points to a removed Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/old-link
ryan: ugh, which file and line?
emma: docs/handbooks/serving/runtime-kernels.md around line ~48: `See kernel manifest: https://docs.google.com/document/d/old-link`
theo: cc @platform-docs — we generally avoid external google docs in handbooks. can we rehost the manifest on our CDN or assets?
platform-docs: +1 to rehosting on CDN for stable perms. prefer path: https://cdn.redwood.com/assets/kernels/kernel-manifest-v2.json. i'll ask infra for an upload token and retention notes.
emma: opened a tiny PR to swap the link and add CODEOWNERS so ownership is clear: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1499 — sed one-liner + CODEOWNERS change
ryan: dropping the sed here for reviewers:
```
rg "docs.google.com/document/d/old-link" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i 's|https://docs.google.com/document/d/old-link|https://cdn.redwood.com/assets/kernels/kernel-manifest-v2.json|g' {}
```
theo: looks good. add `docs/handbooks/serving/ @eng-platform` to CODEOWNERS and a changelog bullet under /docs/CHANGELOG.md
link-checker-bot: automated link scan: /handbooks/serving runtime collection 1 broken link detected, opened issue #431, scan_ts=1768588888
emma: PR is green and requested reviewers; @ryan can you take a quick look?
ryan: reviewing now, should be a tiny approve. :eyes:
theo: if no blockers i'll merge after review and ping infra about the asset upload procedure
ryan: LGTM, merged at 1768589700
emma: awesome, thanks all. left a short note in the handbook explaining why external docs were replaced and who to ping for manifest updates.
